title: Variance-Adaptive Upper Confidence Bounds for Multi-Armed Bandits with Kaplan--Meier Survival Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24988v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the stochastic multi-armed bandit problem in which the reward associated with each arm is the survival probability at a pre-specified time horizon, and the observed outcome is a right-censored time-to-event variable. Standard bandit algorithms face delayed and partial observations in this setting. Prior adaptations for the Kaplan--Meier (KM) estimator rely on Hoeffding-type bounds that ignore the inherent heteroscedasticity of continuous survival processes. To bridge this gap, we propose KM-UCB, a variance-adaptive policy that unites continuous-time survival analysis with discrete sequential decision-making. By leveraging martingale theory and continuous influence functions, we derive a fixed-cohort empirical Bernstein bound parameterized by Greenwood's variance formula. For realtime allocation, we retain the Greenwood index and use a survival bound from completed records to review the recommended arm. Under catch-up reporting

translated_title: 基于Kaplan–Meier生存估计的多臂老虎机方差自适应置信上界算法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了随机多臂老虎机问题，其中与每个臂相关联的奖励是在预先指定时间范围内的生存概率，而观测到的结果是一个右删失的事件时间变量。在这种设置下，标准老虎机算法面临延迟和不完整的观测。先前针对Kaplan–Meier (KM) 估计器的改进方法依赖于Hoeffding类型的界限，忽略了连续生存过程固有的异方差性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了KM-UCB，一种方差自适应策略，将连续时间生存分析与离散序贯决策相结合。通过利用鞅理论和连续影响函数，我们推导出了以Greenwood方差公式为参数的固定队列经验Bernstein界限。对于实时分配，我们保留Greenwood指数，并使用来自已完成记录的生存界限来审查所推荐的臂。在追赶式报告机制下……
tldr: 该论文提出了KM-UCB，一种基于Greenwood方差公式和经验Bernstein界限的方差自适应多臂老虎机策略，将连续时间生存分析与序贯决策相结合以处理右删失数据下的异方差问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes KM-UCB, a variance-adaptive multi-armed bandit policy that combines continuous-time survival analysis with sequential decision-making by leveraging Greenwood's variance formula and empirical Bernstein bounds to address heteroscedasticity under right-censored observations.
